A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the lower right corner of the game-text box frame, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 17 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-astromechshortage-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Astromech Shortage (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same game text. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title, and the text box set again. There is no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the game-text box frame.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
